text: Manchester United defender Jonny Evans and Newcastle striker Papiss Cisse were charged by the FA for allegedly spitting at each other during a Premier League match at St James' Park. The incident was caught on video but not seen by officials; players have until Friday to respond and could face six-game bans. Evans denies spitting, while Cisse said he reacted unpleasantly.
